Details of Kshethram:
This Kshethram is constituted of three temples.

1) Tanjai Mamanikoyil
Moolavar: Neelamegha Perumal
Thayaar: Senkamalavalli Thayaar
Vimanam: Soundarya Vimanam
Pushkarani: Kannika Pushkarani
2) Manikkunram
Moolavar: Manikkundra Perumal
Thayaar: Ambujavalli Thayaar
Vimanam: Manikoota Vimanam
Pushkarani: Sri Rama Theertham
3) Thanjaiyazhinagar
Moolavar: Narasimhar
Thayaar: Tanjainaayaki Thayaar
Vimanam: Vedasundara Vimanam
Pushkarani: Surya Pushkarani
Travel: The three temples are 200 meters apart and are all located on the outskirts of Tanjavur.

Azhwar Pasuram: 
Thirumangai Azhwar – 3 Pasurams
NammAzhwar – 1 pasuram
BhoodathAzhwar – 1 pasuram.
Total – 5 Pasurams.

Sthala Puranam:
The legend is said to have taken place in Krita Yugam. Parashara Maharishi was said to have been performing tapas when three demons, known as Thanjakan, Dhandakan, and Gajamukhan, began to interrupt him. It is then that Parashara Maharishi asked Lord Vishnu to intervene and help him. The Lord mounted Garudan and first released his Sudarshana Chakram to deal with Thanjakan. On his deathbed, Thanjakan asked the Lord to name the land where he died after him. Thus, the land where he died became Tanjavur. Next, the Lord went after Dhandakan. The Lord took the form of Varaha and bore his teeth into Dhandakan, digging through the land and emerging out of Srimushnam just as He had after killing Hiranyaksha. Dhandakan asked for the land where he was buried to be named after him. Thus emerged the Dhandaka Vanam. The last demon, Gajamukhan, was killed by the Lord in his Narasimha form. Therefore, the three temples were combined to form one kshethram, known collectively as Tanjai Mamanikoyil.
